_comment: Thematic overlay for NSE stocks. Each theme can match via any of: basic_industry (regex on NSE official field), industry, sector, macro, ticker (exact, comma-sep), or name_regex on company name. A stock can belong to multiple themes. Rules are intentionally hand-curated — they express the analyst's view of what moves together in the market cycle, not the NSE classification.

themes.name: Defense & Aerospace
themes.description: Defense ordnance, shipyards, electronics, UAVs, and aerospace suppliers. Strong capex + PLI tailwinds.

themes.name: Electric Vehicles
themes.description: EV OEMs, battery makers, motor/BLDC & power electronics suppliers, EV charging infra.

themes.name: Renewables & Clean Energy
themes.description: Solar, wind, hydro, green hydrogen, energy storage. Adani Green / NTPC Green + manufacturers.

themes.name: Semiconductors & Electronics Manufacturing
themes.description: Indian EMS/ODM, display glass, PCB, semicap equipment suppliers.

themes.name: Railways & Metro Capex
themes.description: Rolling stock, signaling, wheelsets, coaches, station redevelopment.

themes.name: PSU Capex Beneficiaries
themes.description: State-owned enterprises riding India's infrastructure/defense/power capex cycle.

themes.name: Broad Capital Goods Cycle
themes.description: Heavy engineering, turbines, T&D, industrial automation. Private capex barometer.

themes.name: Specialty Chemicals
themes.description: Agrochemical intermediates, dyes/pigments, fluorochem, performance chemicals.

themes.name: CDMO / CRAMS Pharma
themes.description: Contract drug manufacturing, APIs with scale. Pharma export cycle beneficiaries.

themes.name: Branded Formulations Pharma
themes.description: Domestic-led branded formulations — relatively lower China exposure.

themes.name: Hospitals & Healthcare Services
themes.description: Listed hospital chains and diagnostics.

themes.name: Private Banks
themes.description: Private-sector banks (high retail + corporate mix).

themes.name: PSU Banks
themes.description: Public-sector banks — cheap multiples, cyclical book growth.

themes.name: Small Finance & Microfinance
themes.description: SFBs and NBFC-MFIs — granular retail credit.

themes.name: NBFC — Retail & Diversified
themes.description: Retail-lending NBFCs (housing, gold, vehicle, MFI, personal).

themes.name: Capital Markets & Exchanges
themes.description: Brokers, AMCs, depositories, exchanges — leveraged on retail-investor flow.

themes.name: Life Insurance
themes.description: Listed life insurers.

themes.name: General & Health Insurance
themes.description: Non-life and standalone health insurers.

themes.name: FMCG Staples
themes.description: Rural-tied consumption staples — food, personal care.

themes.name: Premium Consumer Discretionary
themes.description: Urban consumption — jewelry, QSR, apparel, travel, liquor.

themes.name: Metals & Mining
themes.description: Ferrous + non-ferrous + miners — global-cyclical.

themes.name: Cement
themes.description: Cement producers — infra/housing proxy.

themes.name: Oil & Gas — Upstream
themes.description: E&P + gas exploration — levered on crude.

themes.name: Oil & Gas — Downstream & Gas Utilities
themes.description: Refiners, OMCs, gas distribution.

themes.name: IT Services
themes.description: Traditional IT services — TCS, Infosys, mid-tier.

themes.name: New-Age Tech (Internet/Fintech)
themes.description: Listed internet & fintech IPOs — loss-making to profitable growth.

themes.name: Real Estate
themes.description: Residential, commercial and REITs.

themes.name: Data Center & Digital Infra
themes.description: DC REITs, hyperscaler suppliers, fibre & transmission beneficiaries.

themes.name: Rural & Agri
themes.description: Tractors, pumps, fertilizers, agri-inputs — rural demand cycle.

themes.name: Logistics & Supply Chain
themes.description: Port, 3PL, express, courier, warehousing.
